claim: In the matching retail DLL, PlayerController_AI.UpdatePlayer (0x06004F87) is a parameterless instance method with an exact 836-byte body. It begins by zeroing PlPosOfs and copying State to PrevState. When hasRight is set, hasRightFrm<=0 causes plCont_AI.CalcTouchTime(), then hasRightFrm increments; otherwise hasRightFrm resets to zero. It then calls, in emitted order, MakeKeyData, ProcessRecover, CheckFallToOutOfRing and TransitStateAfterAnm. Raw Status2 mask 64 triggers ChangeState(10), animator.ReqBasicAnm(animator.WazaRequest,true,TargetPlIdx), then Status2 &= -65. The method continues through MultiGrappleCheck, Process_Down, GatherInformation, DecideTargetEnemy, target-direction selection, TagTouchCheck, TagHelpCheck, TransitZone, StandardKeyInput, FlyingMove, ProcessRun, FrontHeadLock, ProcessRopeEscape and ProcessCageAct. When signed State<=4 it clears isDisableUpdateDownTime; isLoseAndStop calls SetBP(0); raw padOn mask 256 takes ChangeState(4) and, when PrevState differs from State, ReqBasicAnm(496 + AnmOfsTbl_3Dir[PlDir],false,-1); otherwise raw padOn mask 15 selects ProcessWalk versus WrestlerStand. In that same State<=4 region, when forceControl and isSecond are both false it stores isPossibleToGrapple=1. It then always calls GrappleCheck and animator.UpdateAnimation. Raw Zone 8 executes the exact Ring collision-line geometry block and stores PlPos.z = NearestPointOnSegment_Normalized(...) * 1.5f. Positive FormRen.PoisonedCnt is decremented, then VibratePlayer is called. reboundTimes is cleared unless State is raw 5 or 32. When requestedForceControl is nonzero and State is one of raw {0,1,2,3,6}, Start_ForceControl(requestedForceControl) is called and requestedForceControl is cleared. ProcessBloodstain is the final call before return. FACT-0046 pins the direct CalcTouchTime call at IL+0x0034. Matching-DLL Update_EntranceScene and Update_Match call this method at IL+0x00CC and IL+0x026F respectively.
